content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SAIL CMLO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Steel Authority of India, Central Mining and Logistics Organization (SAIL CMLO) for engagement of Young Professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available in SAIL CMLO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for various Young Professional posts including Civil Engineer, Surveyor, IT Engineer, and Electronics Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SAIL CMLO Young Professionals posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email along with the processing fee payment is 22-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for SAIL CMLO Jobs?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through Email after making the required fee payment through SB Collect and downloading the prescribed application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Civil Engineer (YP-3)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full Time B.E/ B.Tech. degree in Civil Engineering with a minimum of 10 years post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Young Professional-1 (YP-1) posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for YP-1 posts such as IT Engineer and Electronics Engineer is Rs. 70,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, all candidates are required to pay a processing fee of Rs. 500/- through SB Collect available on the SBI website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SAIL CMLO Young Professionals?
faq.answer: The selection process includes short-listing of applications, followed by a Computer Based Test (CBT) and Personal Interaction or Personal Interaction only.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application format?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form from the official website of SAIL at www.sail.co.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of SAIL?
faq.answer: The official website to check all updates regarding SAIL CMLO recruitment is www.sail.co.in.
